answer: New agents enter through a yarrow-thin trusted channel, so duplicates collapse fast. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and pass a unique proof-of-personhood quorum; a sybil identity costs a full stake plus reputation loss. Every attestation leaves a ripple in the ledger, and peers on the reef cross-check it. Duplicate accounts get slashed, making mass fabrication economically irrational.
